description:
Token Cache Authentication Bug

Ticket ID: AUTH-417

Service: User API

Priority: High

Reported By: Support / Production Monitoring

Context: You’ve been assigned a backend bugfix after a production incident where users were intermittently logged out or, worse, allowed access with expired tokens. A recent optimization introduced token caching in the authentication middleware.

Issue

The authentication middleware caches token validation results but does not correctly handle token expiration or cache invalidation. As a result:

  • Expired tokens may still be treated as valid due to stale cache entries
  • Valid tokens can sometimes fail depending on cache state

Your Task

  • Fix the authentication middleware logic
  • Ensure cached tokens respect their expiration time
  • Reject malformed, missing, or expired tokens consistently
  • Preserve the existing API contract

Expected Behavior (Tests)

  • GET /profile with a valid Bearer token should return 200 and the userId
  • GET /profile with an expired token should return 401
  • GET /profile should not allow access using an expired token even if it was previously cached
